candidates.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
candidates.summary: Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.

candidates.title: OpenAI Codex on Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: A practical guide for enterprises rolling out OpenAI Codex to developers on AWS, with Amazon Bedrock as the model backend, covering the access, governance, and cost decisions that platform, security, and finance teams need to align on.

candidates.title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
candidates.summary: OpenAI commits $2 million to research on AI and children’s safety. The work supports shared tools to measure risks and opportunities for young people.

candidates.title: Fine-grained access control for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base tools
candidates.summary: Learn how to expose an Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base to AI agents as MCP tools through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway while keeping per-user access control. A request interceptor injects verified identity, Policy in AgentCore validates it independently, and a resource-based policy restricts direct access to the knowledge base.

candidates.title: Gondola doubles revenue as its team builds more with Codex
candidates.summary: Gondola helps creatives get credit and get hired, with Codex raising its lead engineer’s output by 50% and ChatGPT simplifying daily work.

candidates.title: Try Tabletop: Customizable, collaborative spaces for groups to plan, play and do more together.
candidates.summary: Tabletop is a new Google Labs experiment for group collaboration. Build interactive itineraries, polls, and brackets with your team. Join the waitlist.

candidates.title: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?
